scope: Tracked and non-ignored files with .md, .py, .m, .txt or .pdf suffixes; an overinclusive file-level queue, not an enumeration of distinct theorems. Other files, ignored caches and absent originals are not reviewed by this tracker.
semantics: not_rechecked_in_this_sweep does not erase prior audits. selected_claims_reviewed means only the listed scope, not a complete file audit. A reviewed-file or evidence hash change marks the receipt stale; tests are not independent proof.
